component.name: dev-setup
component.description: Interactive, idempotent dev-toolchain installer for Ubuntu 26.04 (with target-OS selection), plus a native winget-based Windows installer

properties.name: scope
properties.value: Every third-party component the installer modules explicitly install or fetch: distro packages, vendor repos and .debs, tarballs, container images, VS Code extensions, and Claude Code plugins. Transitive package dependencies are resolved by apt/dnf at install time and are not enumerated. Versions marked with a 'resolution' property are resolved at install time; pinned versions live in config/versions.env and this file is maintained alongside it.

properties.name: note
properties.value: Quantization-aware-trained 26B MoE (3.8B active). Chosen over the 31B dense, whose sliding-window KV cost caps usable context near 32-40K on a 24GB GPU. Variant pinned at num_ctx 131072.

properties.name: resolution

properties.name: note

properties.name: resolution

properties.name: note
properties.value: Hybrid Mamba-2/MoE with only 6 attention layers, so KV cost is near-flat with context depth. Fetched from Hugging Face rather than the Ollama library because the library tag is Q4_K_M (24GB), which cannot fit a 24GB GPU; IQ4_XS (18.2GB) can.
